name: Undamaged Venom Sac
summary: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon needs a fresh sample of venom. You search the Hinterlands for the spiders that yield it, and the sac must reach him fresh.

sections.title: A Fresh Sample
sections.body: After Venom Bottles, Apothecary Lydon asks you for a fresher sample. The spiders that yield the venom live in the Hinterlands, many near the troll city of Shadra'Alor. Lydon wants an undamaged venom sac, delivered while it is fresh. He is eager to experiment with it and has ordered several small, terribly cute animals for testing.

faq.q: Who requests the undamaged venom sac?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill asks you for the sac and waits there for its arrival.

faq.q: Where can the spiders be found?
aliases: where to find undamaged venom sac
faq.answer: Many of the spiders live in the Hinterlands near the troll city of Shadra'Alor.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Lydon say not to tarry?
faq.answer: The sac must arrive fresh, so Lydon wants you to bring it without delay.

aliases: what quest comes before undamaged venom sac
faq.answer: This follows Venom Bottles, when you brought Lydon a sample of venom from a Witherbark village.
